issue.title: Only pass Quarkus related props to process launched with quarkusRun task

labels.name: area/devtools
labels.description: Issues/PR related to maven, gradle, platform and cli tooling/plugins

body:
Thanks for reporting and including the reproducer!

The profile is actually set correctly but Quarkus was incorrectly including a system property that was overriding the greeting message.

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/48496 should fix that
So the difference in behaviour between quarkusRun and packaging and running the JAR is expected? What’s the rationale?
Not sure I understand the question

`./gradlew quarkusRun` vs `./gradlew build && java -jar build/quarkus-app/quarkus-run.jar`; they have different behaviour with respect to profile chosen when it is specified in `application.properties`.

Hmmm, just to confirm, this is what I see:

1. Run the application using `./gradlew build && java -jar build/quarkus-app/quarkus-run.jar`.
2. Navigate to http://localhost:8080/hello in a browser.

`Hello from Quarkus` is displayed.

1. Run the application using `./gradlew quarkusRun`.
2. Navigate to http://localhost:8080/hello in a browser.

`Hello from Production` is displayed.
